findings.issue: Wrong furigana: 上手 written with に (上手になる) must read じょうず; うまく would require the spelling 上手くなる/うまくなる. The reading attribute gives うまくなる for 上手になる.
findings.current: <jp reading="れんしゅうすればするほどうまくなる">練習すればするほど上手になる</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="れんしゅうすればするほどじょうずになる">練習すればするほど上手になる</jp>

findings.issue: Misdescribes the structure: in 弟はゲームばかりしている, ばかり attaches to the noun ゲーム; している is just the progressive. The て+ばかり pattern would be ゲームをしてばかりいる. Contradicts the body's own correct rule.
findings.current: ばかり (com a forma て do verbo: している) sugere repetição incômoda e reprovação
findings.suggested: ばかり ligado direto ao substantivo (ゲームばかり) sugere repetição incômoda e reprovação

findings.issue: Sense-changing gloss: 単純 means 'simples / simplicidade'; 'simplório' in pt-BR means tolo/ingênuo (pejorative, about a person) and would lead the learner to misuse the word.
Accent error: the verb form is 'pratica' (você pratica); 'prática' with accent is the noun/adjective.
Same accent error in the exercise prompt translation: verb form should be 'pratica', not 'prática'.
Wrong furigana: 上手になる is read じょうずになる, not うまくなる (うまくなる would be written 上手くなる/うまくなる, and the reading even drops the particle に).
findings.current: <jp reading="れんしゅうすればするほどうまくなる">練習すればするほど上手になる</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="れんしゅうすればするほどじょうずになる">練習すればするほど上手になる</jp>

findings.issue: False structural analysis: in 弟はゲームばかりしている, ばかり attaches to the noun ゲーム; している is just the progressive of する, not a てばかり(いる) construction. The てばかりいる pattern would be ゲームをしてばかりいる.
findings.current: ばかり (com a forma て do verbo: している) sugere repetição incômoda e reprovação: 'vive só jogando'.
findings.suggested: ばかり ligado ao substantivo (ゲームばかり) sugere repetição incômoda e reprovação: 'vive só jogando'.

findings.issue: Sense-changing gloss: 単純 means 'simples, simplicidade (sem complicação)'. 'Simplório' in pt-BR means naive/simple-minded, which is not the base meaning of the word.
findings.suggested: <jp reading="たんじゅん">単純</jp><text>, 'simplicidade, algo simples'.

findings.issue: Accent/word-class error: the verb is 'pratica' (sem acento); 'prática' is the noun and makes the sentence ungrammatical in pt-BR.
Same accent/word-class error in the exercise prompt: the verb 'pratica' must not carry an accent.
